title: evaluateAgent
responsibility: Runs an authenticated Codex evaluator on supplied evidence and validates its structured verdict.

inputs.name: evaluateAgent.input
inputs.description: Requested Codex model, evidence prompt, and Zod schema for the final verdict.

outputs.name: evaluateAgent
outputs.description: Resolves with the schema-validated final response from the bounded, read-only evaluator.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects on process failure, a missing verdict, invalid JSON, or a response outside the supplied schema.
